title: Matthew
author: Traditionally attributed to Matthew the apostle.
audience: Jewish and wider Christian readers, showing Jesus as Messiah and King.
historicalSetting: Matthew presents Jesus as the promised Messiah, Son of David, teacher, King, crucified Savior, and risen Lord.
keyVerse: Matthew 1:21 — "You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins."
christFocus: Matthew centers on Jesus Christ as the promised King who fulfills Scripture, saves from sin, and sends His disciples to all nations.
